hints.content:
The notation $g(-5)$ refers to the output of the function when the input is $x=-5$. If the point $(-5,b)$ is on the graph, then $g(-5)=b$.

We should look for the point on the graph whose $x$-coordinate is $-5$.

The point on the graph whose $x$-coordinate is $-5$ is the point $(-5,-6)$.

**Therefore, $g(-5)=-6$.**
